hypothesis: H10: Campaign 9's donor-specific advantage survives an awake (activity-calibrated) random twin and a generic trained output pathway

interface.output_init: generic DenseSeam default (trained); no geometry preconditioning
interface.trainable: input_seam and output_seam only (888768 params), identical in B/C/D

awake_calibration.metric: mean ||graft_out-graft_in||/||graft_in|| over 8 TRAIN windows at initialization
awake_calibration.target: native donor sector relative update on the same windows
awake_calibration.adjustment: single scalar on each graft block's o_proj/down_proj weights, bounds [0.05, 100], one correction allowed
awake_calibration.success: achieved activity within [0.5, 2.0] x target, all finite; else AWAKE_CALIBRATION_FAILED / INVALID_CONTROL

gates.held_out: NOT_RUN_NO_PROMOTION unless all promotion gates pass

outcomes.B: replicated advantage vs awake twin, not useful
outcomes.C: no reliable advantage vs awake twin
